source: DR 08 T5-2 — the H-7 regression: employee PF counted in the s.123 aggregate
_source: **Assertion: the deduction is the same, but A3's reported 80C headroom differs by ₹1,20,000** — "this is why the test must assert the trace, not just the total". T5-1's facts; the s.123 line's aggregate is 1,20,000 + 30,000 + 60,000 + 1,00,000 = 3,10,000, not the regression's 1,90,000 (erratum below DR 08 T5, D-153).
